title: Patisserie Ledger
description: A copper-and-marble match-three — craft boosters, clear layered obstacles, and conquer four bakery districts.
detailedDescription: Match pastries on flour-dusted marble in a fully illustrated patisserie campaign. Sixty levels across four districts with varied objectives—orders, vessel fills, garnish drops, and rush-timer service—plus layered obstacles like wax wrap, caramel glaze, and spreading jam. Gather ingredients during play, craft whisk and rolling-pin boosters between levels, and earn stars to unlock the Master's Table.
controls: Drag or tap adjacent pastries to swap · P pause · Pantry between levels
